source: i want a ship to be able to walk on and the name is RMS Willow of the Sea a two Red Funnel ship with two masts and 75 lifeboats pls

image_prompt.text: Two tall red funnels and two masts rising from the deck, visible from anywhere on the ship and from off the water
Clear walkable promenade decks running the length of the vessel, bow to stern, so movement has an obvious grain
Composed vantage points on the bow, stern and boat deck built to look good to stand and look out from
A large ocean liner, the RMS Willow of the Sea, with a fully walkable exterior deck, superstructure and bridge amidships
75 lifeboats mounted along both sides of the ship

notes: No game type was described - this is a place, specifically a named vessel, so it routes to no-genre.

Verticality was set to stacked rather than the default: a liner with a boat deck over a promenade deck over an open well deck overhangs itself, and building it single-surface would flatten the thing the user asked to walk on. That costs P2.
The Explorable Place preset's shape is all-axis-default; the stacked verticality above overrides it.
75 lifeboats is an exact count with nowhere in the handoff to live.

open_questions.ask: What era and condition - a polished Edwardian liner, a modern cruise ship, or a wreck?
Just the exterior decks, or do you go inside the cabins and bridge too?
How long should the ship be - a few hundred studs, or a full liner near a thousand?

coverage_missing.ask: What period and condition should the ship read as?
Are interiors walkable, or exterior decks only?
Is there anything to do aboard, or is it a place to explore?

answers.ask: What era and condition - a polished Edwardian liner, a modern cruise ship, or a wreck?
answers.answer: Make it a polished Edwardian-style ocean liner in good condition, using the Red Funnel look.

answers.ask: Just the exterior decks, or do you go inside the cabins and bridge too?
answers.answer: Include walkable exterior decks plus a simple interior with cabins and the bridge.

answers.ask: How long should the ship be - a few hundred studs, or a full liner near a thousand?
answers.answer: Make it a few hundred studs long so it stays practical and fully walkable.
